title: Thyroid Cancer in United Arab Emirates
brief_summary: The main objective of the study is to assess the trend of clinicopathological features and treatment modalities in patients with thyroid cancer in the largest oncology center in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with Thyroid Cancer presenting to Tawam Hospital during the period of September 2008 and December 2018.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with inadequate data, noninvasive follicular type PTC and incorrect pathological diagnosis,
study_population: All patients with Thyroid Cancer presenting to Tawam Hospital during the period of September 2008 and December 2018. Those with incorrect pathological diagnosis, incomplete data, or noninvasive follicular type PTC were excluded.
